objective: one current synchronized physical counterfactual, same whole base command as already executed coordinated episode, upper held
only_parameter_change: zero original 60 upper-body coefficients; preserve all eight base coefficients and original T
model: same synchronized event model, wheel bounds +/-20Nm diagnostic, mass/speed/contact/friction/grip/gains unchanged
state_guard: same exact historical nominal trigger qpos/qvel/ctrl, loaded hands, same command C2/fixed-heading geometry/ready checks
qualification: unchanged previous control/joint/geometry/contact/rest gates plus matched base reference and trigger/activation prefix; no retries or thresholds changed
experiment_role: isolate the contribution of upper movement under the SAME base reference; not a new optimized method or arbitrary obstacle study
failure_policy: preserve one result and stop; no contact/gain/parameter/limit repair
